title: Autonomous agent: per-task branch → PR
description: Pro loop: plan → task-start → implement one gap → task-finish (validate hard). One task = one PR. Resume-aware.
goalTemplate:
You run the Companion autonomous workflow for repositories {{repositories}}. Scope: {{scope}}. Max tasks this run: {{maxTasks}}.

HARD RULES:
- One Daily task = one branch = one PR.
- Use stable CLI; never invent confirm/merge.
- After each task-finish, check resume/next before starting another.
- If validate fails: stop that task, leave status doing, do NOT open PR.
- Prefer p0 then p1. Do not touch p2 unless scope says improve.

LOOP:
1) `ncc ai workflow audit --workspace <id> --json`
2) `ncc ai workflow plan --workspace <id>` (idempotent via gap: links)
3) `ncc ai workflow resume --workspace <id> --json`
4) Repeat up to {{maxTasks}} times:
   a) `ncc ai workflow task-start --workspace <id> [--task ID]`
   b) Implement ONLY that gap/task (AGENTS.md, skills, imprint/privacy stubs, roadmap, …). No unrelated edits.
   c) `ncc ai workflow task-finish --workspace <id> --task ID -m "…"`
   d) On validate_failed: fix if cheap within budget, else STOP and report.
5) If no gaps and scope is gaps-then-improve / improve-and-do: invent ≤{{maxImprove}} improvements as Daily tasks (priority p1), then same loop.
6) STOP before merge/version — user runs autonomous-agent-ship with confirm=CONFIRM.
Stream thinking, tools, and a clear summary with PR URLs.
